items.root_cause: Hold state and publication state live in meal-prep/db (held-recipes.json, published-hashes.json) and the two scripts that cost the catalogue never read them, so every flag they emit is state-free: a recipe deliberately taken down pages exactly like a live one, and the chain can only count lines. The same state-free file also counts a line that PRICED (a bid on no board, then priced from a label or the ledger) as 'unpriced'. The chain cannot add the state without a new grocery-to-meal-prep read, so the only honest home is the engine, which sits in the module that owns both files.

root_fix.what: the engine labels its own flag lines: a HELD recipe's lines and an ADVISORY line (bid on no board but the line priced) leave cost-flags.txt and are recorded with their counts in costed.stamp.json and printed; a LIVE recipe's lines lead cost-flags.txt with a 'LIVE :: ' prefix; compute-v2 reports a held recipe it cannot price as HELD, not SKIPPED, and exits 0 when only held recipes failed; the chain logs both scripts' disposition lines from their own stdout (no new path)
root_fix.exact_change: cost-recipes.ps1: read db/held-recipes.json held[].slug and db/published-hashes.json keys (unreadable -> WARNING and nothing treated as held, so everything pages: the loud direction); tag each flag line with its recipe slug; mark a 'MAPPED BID NOT ON ANY BOARD' line ' :: ADVISORY, the line priced from <basis>' when that ingredient went on to price; new pure Split-CostFlags writes LIVE lines first (prefixed), then the rest unchanged, and returns held/advisory lines set aside; costed.stamp.json gains flags_set_aside {held_recipes, held_lines, advisory_lines}; stdout 'cost-recipes: HELD n recipe(s) not costed as live, by design ...'. compute-v2-perserving.ps1: a held slug that throws goes to a HELD list printed as 'HELD n recipe(s) not in the manifest, by design (...)' with no leading whitespace; exit 1 only for non-held skips. check-ad-cycles.ps1: Log the engine's 'cost-recipes: (HELD|ADVISORY|LIVE|WARNING)' lines from $crRun.Lines and compute-v2's '^HELD ' line from $cv2.

items.root_cause: The standing carriage watch treats UNKNOWN exactly like NOT-CARRIED: a could-not-look (nobody proved it either way, or the proof left the board for a day) is printed as 'no store carries it' and paged as a takedown. On 2026-09-19 all 25 were UNKNOWN, none NOT-CARRIED, and by 2026-09-20 every named ingredient was back on the board from an in-store shelf read - following the alert would have taken 25 live recipes down over a one-day proof gap. The dispatch's premise that the PUBLISH gate lets UNKNOWN through is false today (publish.ps1 refuses it at the door since 2026-08-22); the door that did not look is the wave pre-audit, which decides GO without reading carriage, so an uncarried wave recipe read GO and was refused only at publish.

root_fix.what: (a) the watch splits NOT-CARRIED (proven absent at all seven stores: Brad's rule, these come down) from UNKNOWN (a could-not-look: resolve by asking the stores, never a takedown) and the chain's alert says which; (b) wave-preaudit refuses a wave row with an ingredient not proven carried, naming it, at the audit that decides GO; a pin asserts publish.ps1 still refuses an uncarried slug and takes nothing down
root_fix.exact_change: audit-carriage.ps1: new pure Split-LiveUncarried; -Live prints '  X <slug>  PROVEN not carried ...' only for a recipe with a [NOT-CARRIED] item and '  ? <slug>  carriage UNKNOWN ...' otherwise, with separate totals; -Json gains live_not_carried and live_unknown beside live_uncarried. check-ad-cycles.ps1: the takedown alert keeps '^\s+X ' (now NOT-CARRIED only); a new '^\s+\?
